title_zh: 约好先检查金属椅子再报价

scenario.label_zh: 约好先检查金属椅子再报价
scenario.goal_zh: 说明金属椅子的折叠故障，并约定由专业人员检查后再提供维修报价

context_zh: 顾客与修理店接待员讨论一把折叠椅，不自行进行结构性维修。
author: author-phase09-b

sentences.speaker: Jonah
sentences.text: The frame is steel, but the seat folds up. Can your shop repair this kind of chair?

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: Yes. We have a specialist in metal furniture. What's wrong with it?

sentences.speaker: Jonah
sentences.text: The folding joint is stiff. I'm worried I'll break it if I force it.

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: Leave it as it is. Our repairer is skilled at working on old joints, but she'll need to see it first.

sentences.speaker: Jonah
sentences.text: Can I bring it in tomorrow and get a price before any work starts?

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: Certainly. Bring it after ten. We'll inspect it, then call you with a quote.

sentences.speaker: Jonah
sentences.text: Good. Please don't start the repair until I've agreed to that quote.
